title: NOC — Network Traffic
description: Interface traffic wallboard for any routers, switches and firewalls: choose Device Type, Devices and Interfaces at the top (kept in the URL). Inbound/outbound traffic, utilization, interface status, errors and discards — all read from Zabbix (host groups, interface discovery tags, item names); nothing is hardcoded.

list.name: devtype
list.label: Device Type
list.description: Zabbix host groups per device type (regex over group names); set once by 'install.sh --dashboards'

list.name: device
list.label: Devices
list.definition: Zabbix hosts in the host groups of the selected Device Type
list.description: Any number of Zabbix hosts of the chosen type (type to search). All = every host of the type; kept in the URL.

list.name: interface
list.label: Interfaces
list.definition: Zabbix item tags 'interface: <name>' of the selected devices (interface discovery)
list.description: Interfaces Zabbix discovered on the selected devices (item tag 'interface'); the list follows the Devices selection. Type to search.

panels.title: Total inbound
panels.description: Sum of the inbound traffic (Bits received) of the selected interfaces, latest value with a 1-minute trend. N/A = no data.

panels.title: Total outbound
panels.description: Sum of the outbound traffic (Bits sent) of the selected interfaces, latest value with a 1-minute trend. N/A = no data.

panels.title: Interfaces
panels.description: Interfaces in the detail table (the current Device / Interface selection).

panels.title: Interfaces UP
panels.description: Selected interfaces whose operational status (ifOperStatus) is up.

panels.title: Interfaces DOWN
panels.description: Selected interfaces whose operational status is down or lowerLayerDown. Unused access ports are down by design: choose the interfaces you care about.

panels.title: Total traffic — inbound and outbound
panels.description: Sum of all selected interfaces, inbound and outbound, both positive. Native Grafana time range.

panels.title: Top 10 busiest interface directions
panels.description: The 10 highest series (average over the time range) among the selected interfaces' inbound (Bits received) and outbound (Bits sent) items.

panels.title: Top 10 utilization — inbound
panels.description: Inbound bit/s divided by the interface Speed item. Interfaces without a Speed or a sample are left out (see the detail table: N/A).

panels.title: Top 10 utilization — outbound
panels.description: Outbound bit/s divided by the interface Speed item. Interfaces without a Speed or a sample are left out (see the detail table: N/A).

panels.title: Inbound by interface — top 10
panels.description: Bits received of the 10 busiest selected interfaces (average over the time range). Legend sorted by current value.

panels.title: Outbound by interface — top 10
panels.description: Bits sent of the 10 busiest selected interfaces (average over the time range). Legend sorted by current value.

panels.title: Errors and discards — top 10
panels.description: Inbound/outbound packets with errors and discarded packets (packets per second) of the 10 worst selected interfaces (peak in the time range).

panels.title: Interfaces DOWN — selected
panels.description: Selected interfaces whose operational status is down or lowerLayerDown (from the detail table).

panels.title: Interfaces — detail
panels.description: One row per selected interface (Device Type / Devices / Interfaces above), busiest inbound first. Speed = item 'Speed' (bit/s); Rx / Tx = latest inbound / outbound bit/s (negative counter resets dropped); Utilization = Rx or Tx divided by Speed. Anything not available is N/A, never 0 (Speed items polled less often than every 15m give N/A utilization). Click a device to open NOC — Device Health.
